notes: The altered or open state is treated as on; closed, installed, or fully inserted is off. The two double-door upper cabinets are split into individual hinged leaves as separate movable parts. Their leaf-by-leaf ordering is partly unresolved by the 8-frame sampling. The edge-on view near frame 1312 was treated as temporary occlusion rather than an unsupported close-and-reopen episode.
scene_description: First-person traversal of a residential kitchen while the user opens and later closes appliance doors, cabinet leaves, cooker lids, and an air-fryer drawer.
